capabilities: Create JD items with auto-built parent Area and Category folders
Suggest the next available JD number when creating inside a folder
Hide JD prefixes in the file explorer with a non-destructive Clean View
Reformat Area names as ranges or single numbers in settings
Prevent duplicate JD numbers by scanning existing folders
extras: The README includes a disclaimer that the author is not the creator of the Johnny.Decimal system; the plugin is an independent implementation. Installation is also possible via BRAT or manual download.
motivation: The author wants organization to live in the folder structure itself so it persists on disk, in GitHub or cloud backups, and is easier for AI agents to navigate.
problem: Sorting plugins that rely on Obsidian metadata don't carry over to the hard drive, so files sort inconsistently across platforms, in cloud backups, and for AI agents that read the vault directly.

relations.evidence: All conceptual credit for the original system belongs to johnnydecimal.com

summary: Plugin that creates and organizes folders and files using the Johnny.Decimal numbering system, with a file-explorer view that can hide the numeric prefixes.
